$comment: Seed chapters and prompts. Upserted at startup by stable key: changing text here updates the prompt, but an admin's edits in the app win once made (see DECISIONS D-017). Never reuse or rename a key.

prompts.title: Where you were born
prompts.question: Where and when were you born? Do you know how your name was chosen?
hints: What town or city were you born in? Was it at home or in a hospital?
Were you named after anyone in the family?
Did you have a nickname growing up? How did you get it?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: A baby photo or a birth announcement

prompts.title: The home you grew up in
prompts.question: Describe the home you grew up in: the rooms, the smells, the sounds, the neighborhood.
hints: Which room did your family spend the most time in?
What could you smell from the kitchen?
What did you see when you looked out the front window?
Who were the neighbors?

prompts.title: Your parents
prompts.question: Tell us about your parents. What were they like, and what work did they do?
hints: What is one thing your mother always used to say?
What is one thing your father always used to say?
How did they spend a typical day?
In what ways are you like them?

prompts.title: Your earliest memory
prompts.question: What is your earliest memory?
hints: How old do you think you were?
Where were you, and who was with you?
Why do you think this moment stayed with you?

prompts.title: Grandparents and where we came from
prompts.question: What do you know about your grandparents and where our family came from?
hints: Did you know your grandparents? What were they like?
Where did the family live before, and why did they move?
Are there family stories that have been passed down?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: Old documents, immigration papers, or letters

prompts.title: Games and childhood friends
prompts.question: What games did you play, and who were your childhood friends?
hints: What did you play outside? What did you play when it rained?
Who was your closest friend, and what were they like?
Did you have a favorite toy?

prompts.title: Chores and house rules
prompts.question: What chores did you have, and what were the house rules?
hints: Which chore did you like least?
Did you get an allowance, or anything for helping?
What happened if you broke a rule?

prompts.title: A time you got into trouble
prompts.question: Tell us about a time you got into trouble as a kid.
hints: What did you do, and who caught you?
Were you sorry, or would you do it again?
Was anyone else in on it?

prompts.title: Holidays and traditions
prompts.question: Which holidays and family traditions do you remember most?
hints: What food was always on the table?
Who came to visit, or where did you go?
Is there a tradition you still keep today?

prompts.title: Family fun
prompts.question: What did your family do for fun: trips, Sunday dinners, radio or TV shows?
hints: What did a weekend look like in your house?
Was there a radio or TV program the whole family loved?
Do you remember a special outing or trip?

prompts.title: Your schools and a teacher who mattered
prompts.question: Tell us about your schools. Was there a teacher who made a difference?
hints: How did you get to school each day?
What did your classroom look like?
What did that teacher do or say that you still remember?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: A class photo or a report card

prompts.title: Favorite and least favorite subjects
prompts.question: Which subjects did you love, and which did you dread?
hints: What came easily to you?
Was there a subject you struggled with? How did you get through it?
Do you still use anything you learned in school?

prompts.title: Teenage weekends
prompts.question: What did you and your friends do on weekends as teenagers?
hints: Where did young people gather in your town?
What music did you listen to?
What time did you have to be home?

prompts.title: What you were proud of
prompts.question: What were you proud of in your school years: sports, clubs, music, a job?
hints: Was there a team, a club, or a band you belonged to?
Did you win anything, or work hard for something?
Who cheered you on?

prompts.title: Your first job
prompts.question: What was your first job, and what did you do with your first paycheck?
hints: How old were you, and how did you get the job?
How much were you paid?
What did you learn from it?

prompts.title: Leaving home
prompts.question: When did you leave home, and where did you go?
hints: How did you feel the day you left?
Where did you live first, and who with?
What did you miss most about home?

prompts.title: Military or other service
prompts.question: Did you serve in the military or another kind of service? What do you want us to know about it?
hints: Where were you stationed or where did you serve?
Who were the friends you made there?
Share only what you're comfortable sharing.
prompts.suggestedAttachments: A service photo or discharge papers

prompts.title: What you dreamed of becoming
prompts.question: When you were young, what did you dream of becoming?
hints: Where did that dream come from?
Did it come true, or did life take you somewhere else?
What would you tell your young self?

prompts.title: Your first car
prompts.question: What was your first car, or how did you get around?
hints: What color was it, and how much did it cost?
Where was the first place you drove it?
Who taught you to drive?

prompts.title: How you met
prompts.question: How did you meet your spouse or partner? What was your first impression?
hints: Where were you, and what were you doing?
What did you notice first about them?
What was your first date?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: An early photo of the two of you

prompts.title: Your wedding day
prompts.question: Tell us about your wedding day, or the moment you knew.
hints: Where was it, and who was there?
What do you remember about how you felt?
Did anything funny or unexpected happen?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: A wedding photo or the invitation

prompts.title: The secret to lasting love
prompts.question: What's the secret to a lasting relationship?
hints: What did you learn the hard way?
How did you get through a difficult time together?
What small things mattered most?

prompts.title: Your first home together
prompts.question: Describe your first home together.
hints: Where was it, and how did you find it?
What furniture did you have, or not have?
What do you remember about your first evening there?

prompts.title: Becoming a parent
prompts.question: What do you remember about becoming a parent?
hints: What was the day your first child was born like?
What surprised you most?
Who helped you in those early days?

prompts.title: A funny story about the children
prompts.question: Share a funny or memorable story about your children when they were young.
hints: Is there a story the family still tells at holidays?
Did one of them say something you've never forgotten?

prompts.title: An ordinary week
prompts.question: What was an ordinary week like when the kids were little?
hints: What time did the day start, and who made breakfast?
What did you have for supper most nights?
What did you do on Sundays?

prompts.title: What you hoped to pass on
prompts.question: What did you most hope to pass on to your children?
hints: Which values mattered most to you?
Is there a skill or habit you made sure they learned?
Do you see it in them now?

prompts.title: The hardest and best parts of parenting
prompts.question: What was the hardest part of being a parent, and what was the best part?
hints: Is there a moment you were especially proud?
What do you wish someone had told you?

prompts.title: Your life's work
prompts.question: Tell us about your career or main life's work.
hints: How did you get started?
What did a typical workday look like?
What did you enjoy most about it?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: A work photo, ID badge, or award

prompts.title: Your proudest accomplishment
prompts.question: What accomplishment are you most proud of?
hints: What did it take to get there?
Who was there to see it?
Why does it still matter to you?

prompts.title: A mentor who shaped you
prompts.question: Who was a mentor or boss who shaped you?
hints: How did you meet them?
What did they teach you, or how did they help you?
Did you ever get to thank them?

prompts.title: Community, volunteering, or faith
prompts.question: How have you been involved in your community, volunteering, or faith?
hints: Which groups or places have meant the most to you?
Is there someone you helped, or who helped you, that you remember?

prompts.title: Places you've lived
prompts.question: List the places you've lived, and why you moved each time.
hints: Start with the first place you remember and go in order.
Which move was the hardest?
Which place did you love the most?

prompts.title: The best trip of your life
prompts.question: What was the best trip or vacation of your life?
hints: Where did you go, and who went with you?
How did you get there?
What is the one picture from that trip you still see in your mind?

prompts.title: The place that feels like home
prompts.question: What place feels most like home to you, and why?
hints: Is it a house, a town, or somewhere outdoors?
What do you see, hear, or smell when you think of it?

prompts.title: A time you were brave
prompts.question: Tell us about a time you were brave or tried something completely new.
hints: Were you scared? What helped you go ahead?
How did it turn out?
Would you do it again?

prompts.title: An event you remember vividly
prompts.question: What world or national event do you remember most vividly? Where were you when it happened?
hints: How did you first hear the news?
What did the people around you say or do?
Did it change anything in your own life?

prompts.title: How everyday life has changed
prompts.question: How has everyday life changed since you were young: technology, communication, how people shop and travel?
hints: How did your family keep in touch with relatives far away?
What was the first big new gadget in your home?
What do you miss about the old ways? What are you glad is gone?

prompts.title: What things used to cost
prompts.question: What did things cost when you were young: a movie, gas, a loaf of bread, your first house?
hints: What could you buy with a dollar?
What was your first rent or house payment?

prompts.title: A hard time we got through
prompts.question: Tell us about a hard time our family got through together.
hints: What helped the family keep going?
Who stepped up when it mattered?
What did you learn from it?

prompts.title: A family recipe
prompts.question: Share a family recipe and the story behind it.
hints: Who first made it, and when was it served?
Write down the ingredients and the steps as best you remember.
Is there a secret to getting it just right?
prompts.suggestedAttachments: A photo of the handwritten recipe card

prompts.title: A treasured object
prompts.question: Tell us the story of an heirloom or treasured object.
hints: Where did it come from, and who owned it before you?
Why is it special to you?
Who would you like to have it one day?

prompts.title: Family songs and sayings
prompts.question: What songs, sayings, or expressions did your family always use?
hints: Was there a saying for when things went wrong?
Was there a song someone always sang?
Where do you think it came from?

prompts.title: How holidays have changed
prompts.question: How have birthdays and holidays changed from when you were a child to now?
hints: What did a birthday look like when you were small?
What gifts did children get?
What do you like better now, and what do you miss?

prompts.title: Your brothers and sisters
prompts.question: Tell us about your brothers and sisters and what growing up with them was like.
hints: Where were you in the line-up: oldest, youngest, in between?
Who did you get along with best, and who did you fight with?
Is there a story about them you love to tell?

prompts.title: Your best friend
prompts.question: Who was your best friend over the years?
hints: How did you meet?
What did you do together?
What made them such a good friend?

prompts.title: Someone you miss
prompts.question: Is there someone you miss? Tell us about them.
hints: What did they look like, and how did they talk?
What is a favorite memory of time with them?
What would you say to them today?

prompts.title: Who you're most like
prompts.question: Who in the family do you think you're most like?
hints: Is it the way you look, the way you talk, or the way you do things?
Do people tell you that you remind them of someone?

prompts.title: The best advice
prompts.question: What's the best advice you ever received, and what advice would you give?
hints: Who gave you that advice, and when?
Did you follow it?
What would you tell a young person starting out today?

prompts.title: What you're grateful for
prompts.question: What are you most grateful for?
hints: Think of the people, the places, and the small everyday things.
Is there something you're grateful for now that you didn't value when you were young?

prompts.title: What you want them to know
prompts.question: What do you want your grandchildren and great-grandchildren to know about you?
hints: What do you hope they remember?
What might surprise them about you?
What are you proudest of?

prompts.title: A letter to future generations
prompts.question: Write a letter to future generations of our family.
hints: Start with "Dear family" and write as if they're sitting with you.
Tell them what matters most in life.
End with a wish for them.
